scope: Derived-view deletion/correction propagation and head invalidation
behavior: explicit memory deletion purges candidate and version bodies, marks candidate/version entries deleted, marks the candidate job stale, and clears a head pointing at the invalid version
correcting a memory follows the same propagation and invalidates its derived views
head revision is advanced on invalidation with version_id=NULL, so historical CAS cannot reuse the invalidated head
read paths (getVersion/getCandidate) remain fail-closed after propagation; memory.derived returns head=null when no valid version remains
original memory deletion/correction behavior and unrelated memories are unchanged
limitations: Archive/restore is not treated as deletion propagation in this increment; derived read still fail-closes on non-active memory dependencies.
Only memory dependencies are propagated; excerpt dependency invalidation is not implemented.
No retention/GC policy for non-head historical versions or operation tombstones; only invalid derived bodies are purged.
No real installed-profile published derived view was available to exercise deletion propagation end-to-end in the GUI.
No browser visual verification of the derived card/update after propagation.
